item.title: How to optimize Angular performance
item.description: Optimizing Angular performance involves change detection strategies, lazy loading, bundle optimization, and runtime performance improvements. As the creator of CoreUI, I’ve optimized numerous enterprise applications for production performance. Angular provides powerful optimization tools including OnPush change detection, lazy loading, and AOT compilation for faster applications. This approach ensures smooth user experience even in complex, data-heavy applications.
